battles.description: Read every row over the player's last N battles (1 to 10000) instead of the vehicle's career. Give at most one of this or `days`. Random Battles only: ignored under any other `mode`.

days.description: Read every row over the last N days (1 to 365) instead of the vehicle's career. Give at most one of this or `battles`. Random Battles only: ignored under any other `mode`.
